Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
model.vehicle.Vehicle
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, Motorcycle
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object
Represents a vehicle registered with the campus parking system. Every vehicle has a VIN, make, model, parking rate, and running state.
